requirements: Basic understanding of UI/UX design principles and website usability.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify visual and functional inconsistencies.
Ability to document issues clearly and provide practical recommendations.
Familiarity with web browsers, responsive design, and common website interactions.
Willingness to learn QA methodologies, usability testing, and modern review tools.
Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks in a remote environment.
responsibilities: We're looking for a detail-oriented UI/UX Reviewer & Quality Assurance (QA) professional to review websites, landing pages, and web applications to ensure they provide a smooth, intuitive, and consistent user experience.

In this role, you'll evaluate user interfaces, identify usability issues, check design consistency, and help ensure that digital products meet quality standards before they reach users. You'll work with design and development teams to provide actionable feedback and help improve the overall user experience.

This opportunity is suitable for individuals who have an interest in UI/UX design, website usability, and software quality assurance. Familiarity with modern design tools and AI-powered productivity tools is a plus.
Review websites, landing pages, and web applications for usability, accessibility, and visual consistency.
Evaluate user interfaces to identify layout issues, confusing navigation, inconsistent spacing, and design inconsistencies.
Perform quality assurance checks across different browsers, screen sizes, and devices.
Identify and document bugs, UI defects, and user experience issues with clear descriptions and supporting screenshots.
